work_units.responsibility: Split the public option surface into stable top-level configuration modules

findings.claim: options.nix is a compatibility aggregator over fourteen focused top-level option modules.
All split option modules parse, format, and preserve representative gc-02 and gs-02 evaluations.

gaps: Git-backed flake evaluation excludes the unrelated untracked host-common.nix; path: evaluation was used.

work_units.responsibility: Split systemd unit declarations into one-service subservice modules

findings.claim: config.nix now composes thirty-seven one-service leaf modules through one shared service context.
Each leaf documents its purpose and command while colocating only same-name timers or paths.
The worker aggregator declares no service and composes nine one-service Celery modules.

gaps: The repository tracker directory now contains a concurrently restored legacy YAML that does not match the feature schema.
